tile-repair-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.source: Cracked, chipped or loose tiles do not always call for a whole new floor. We repair affected areas, prepare the base and work with available matching tiles to blend the replacement into your existing finish. Small repairs are welcome.

tile-repair-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.source: A small repair or single-tile replacement can suit isolated damage where the base and adjoining finish remain serviceable. tile-repair-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.source: Replacing a few damaged tiles is different from laying a connected room or renewing a whole floor. Wider work needs a layout, base and finished-height assessment; see

tile-repair-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.target: 防溅墙排砖与接缝准备

tile-repair-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.source: Spare original tiles help with matching, but size, thickness, finish and colour still need checking. Age, wear and grout colour can make a replacement stand out. For discontinued tiles, we discuss an available near match, a contrasting replacement or retiling a defined section. Similar colour alone is not enough: the tile must fit the space and finished level. We agree the visible difference and repair boundary before removal; a perfect match is not guaranteed.
tile-repair-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.target: 原装备用砖有助于匹配，但仍需检查尺寸、厚度、饰面及颜色。使用年限、磨损与填缝颜色可能让新砖显眼。停产砖可讨论近似替换、对比色替换或指定区域翻铺。仅颜色近似不够，瓷砖还需适合尺寸与完成面高度。拆除前确认可见差异和维修边界，不保证完全一致。

tile-repair-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.source: Tell us whether cracking, looseness or a hollow sound is recent, recurring or spreading, and whether you have spare matching tiles. We check adjoining tiles and movement joints as well as visible damage. A small repair enquiry does not need a prior diagnosis; repeated cracking or several loose tiles may need a broader base assessment rather than another isolated replacement.
tile-repair-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.target: 请说明开裂、松动或空鼓声是近期出现、反复发生还是正在扩大，以及有无备用同款砖。我们同时检查相邻瓷砖、伸缩缝及可见损伤。小维修无需事先诊断；反复开裂或多块松动可能需扩大基层评估，而非再次单独换砖。

tile-repair-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.source: Tile removal and the condition of the base beneath

Removing a tile can expose weak adhesive, an uneven base or damage that was not visible beforehand. We assess the exposed condition before reinstatement. Work proceeds on the agreed basis; if additional preparation or a larger repair is needed, the change is discussed with you first.
tile-repair-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.target: 拆砖可能暴露胶层薄弱、基层不平或原先不可见的损坏。恢复前会评估打开后的状况，按约定依据施工；需要额外基层处理或扩大维修时，会先与您讨论。

tile-repair-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.source: In a shower or another waterproofed area, removal also needs to consider the concealed membrane. A replacement tile does not repair a damaged waterproofing layer. If there is leaking or membrane damage, see
tile-repair-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.target: 淋浴或其他防水区域拆砖，还需考虑隐蔽防水膜。替换瓷砖不能修复损坏防水层。存在渗漏或膜层损伤时，请参阅

tile-repair-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.source: . For sound tiles with worn joints,
Tile repair preparation, access and quote factors
tile-repair-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.target: 瓷砖维修的准备、通行与报价因素

tile-repair-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.source: Tile quantity, format, location, removal difficulty and matching stock affect the written quote. Base repairs, nearby surface protection and joint finishing can add work beyond replacing the tile. We confirm these inclusions even for a small job before starting.
tile-repair-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.target: 瓷砖数量、规格、位置、拆除难度及匹配砖供应影响书面报价。基层维修、周边保护与接缝收口可能增加换砖以外的工作。即使小项目，也会在开工前确认包含内容。

tile-repair-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.source: Access to the room or walkway, adhesive and grout curing, and any waterproofing work determine the schedule and return-to-use point. An exterior repair may also depend on suitable weather. If matching tiles need sourcing, their availability is considered before confirming the installation sequence.
tile-repair-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.target: 房间或通道的可进入条件、胶层与填缝养护、防水工作决定施工顺序及恢复使用时间。室外维修还可能依赖合适天气。需采购匹配砖时，会先考虑供应，再确认安装安排。

tile-repair-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.source: Using the repaired surface after handover

Keep traffic and loads off the repair until the confirmed curing period is complete. We explain cleaning and use restrictions for the installed materials and the repaired location. Avoid testing the new tile by standing on it or moving furniture across it before it is ready.
tile-repair-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.target: 在确认的养护期结束前，避免踩踏或加载。我们说明所用材料和维修位置的清洁与使用限制；未就绪前不要踩上新砖测试，也不要拖动家具经过。

tile-repair-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.source: Report renewed cracking, movement or dampness, especially if it appears beyond the repair boundary. These changes may require a wider assessment. General questions about tile supply, joint care and work timing belong in the
tile-repair-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.target: 出现新的开裂、位移或潮湿时，尤其超出原维修边界，应及时反馈并评估是否扩大检查。瓷砖供应、接缝保养与工期问题请参阅

tile-repair-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.source: For cracked porcelain or chipped ceramic tiles, we compare the spare tile size, thickness, edge and finish with the existing surface. A marble-look or timber-look pattern also needs the face direction and variation considered. We prepare the repair area and plan adjoining grout lines so the replacement sits naturally within the floor or wall.
tile-repair-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.target: 维修开裂瓷质砖或崩角陶瓷砖时，我们对比备用砖与现有饰面的尺寸、厚度、边缘和表面。仿大理石或木纹图案还需考虑纹路方向与变化，处理维修区基层并衔接周边砖缝，让替换砖融入原有墙地面。

tile-repair-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.source: Loose or hollow-sounding tiles need the affected base and neighbouring finish checked alongside the visible damage. For a repair quote, tell us the location, number of affected tiles and whether matching spares are available. You can contact us before purchasing replacement tiles.
tile-repair-adelaide.html/html[1]/body[2.target: 松动或空响瓷砖需结合可见损伤检查受影响基层与相邻饰面。询价时说明位置、受影响数量及是否有同款备砖；不必先买好替换砖再联系我们。
